# Assessment Overview

Supplementary analysis for Photo Album. These documents describe the checked-in application; runtime deployment behavior has not been verified. Credential values are redacted.

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md): Application layers, deployment dependencies, technology stack, and component relationships.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md): Declared runtime and test dependencies, version sources, and compatibility considerations.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md): HTTP endpoints, request and response contracts, authentication, and communication sequences.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md): Entity model, Oracle persistence, repository queries, schema lifecycle, and data sensitivity.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, profiles, environment variables, startup dependencies, and secret handling.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md): Upload, gallery, navigation, image retrieval, and deletion flows with business rules and sequence diagrams.

See the parent [assessment report](../report.md) for core and security findings.
